answer: New identities begin as embers in a shared meadow: each locks a bond of 30,000 POA and must complete a supervised voyage through three independent waystations, each checking one fresh proof of real work and stamping it. A waystation that catches a fake proof burns the bond, half pays the whistleblower, the identity is banned 10 epochs and its meadow plot is reclaimed. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns 1,000 x 30,000 = 30,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond of 30,000 POA once. The limit: three waystations can still be bribed together if a single operator controls them all.
